description.en: Holds aloft a boom box that tranquilizes all plants with its heartfelt tunes.
description.zh: 高举着音箱，用美妙的曲调安抚所有植物。

chat.en: Boombox Zombie doesn't want to buy, sell or process anything; he just really wants to consume your brains.
chat.zh: 音箱僵尸不想买卖或编写任何音乐，他只想消化你的大脑。

text.en: boombox has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets
text.zh: 音箱对地下植物和魔音甜菜无效
